data.name: migration.sql
data.summary: Initial Prisma SQL migration that creates the core duel persistence schema, including match, player, and participant tables with indexes and foreign keys.

data.name: matches
data.summary: Stores one record per logged duel with the game identifier, duration, creation timestamp, and ingestion timestamp.

data.name: players
data.summary: Stores player identity data used to associate duel participants with Riot account fields and local timestamps.

data.name: match_players
data.summary: Represents each participant row within a duel, linking matches and players while storing per-side statistics and team uniqueness constraints.

data.name: migration.sql
data.summary: Adjusts the primary key type for match identifiers from `BIGINT` to `INTEGER` across the match and participant tables while preserving the foreign-key relationship.

data.name: migration.sql
data.summary: Adds the raw event ingestion table and supporting indexes needed to queue, deduplicate, and track processing state for inbound event payloads.

data.name: raw_events
data.summary: Stores raw inbound event payloads alongside processing status, retry metadata, timestamps, and a deduplication key.

data.name: schema.prisma
data.summary: Defines the Prisma data model for matches, players, participant rows, and raw ingestion events, along with their indexes, mappings, and enum state machine.

config.name: package.json
config.summary: Node package manifest for the server runtime defining API and worker scripts, Prisma and Express dependencies, and the test toolchain. It controls how the backend is started, tested, and developed.

config.name: tsconfig.json
config.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the server codebase, setting NodeNext modules, strict type-checking, declaration output, and generated source inclusion. It defines the backend's compilation boundaries and safety defaults.

config.name: payload.json
config.summary: Example transformed `MATCH_SNAPSHOT` payload with normalized match fields and a two-player duel roster.

config.name: pyproject.toml
config.summary: Defines the client Python project metadata, Python version floor, runtime dependencies, and pytest as the development test dependency.

config.name: lcu_match_raw.json
config.summary: Large raw League Client match-history fixture representing a completed two-player custom game response for transformation and validation tests.

config.name: commands.json
config.summary: Draft command definition document describing planned Telegram bot commands, effects, and argument variants for match statistics queries.

config.name: migration_lock.toml
config.summary: Pins the Prisma migration history to the PostgreSQL provider so migration tooling uses a consistent database backend.

config.name: match-snapshot.json
config.summary: Provides a representative match snapshot fixture with duel metadata and two participant records for server-side tests.

list.name: Client Capture Layer
list.description: Local Python collector code that discovers the League Client, validates 1v1 match snapshots, and submits duel events to the backend.

list.name: Server API Layer
list.description: Express entrypoints, controllers, and routes that expose ingest and query endpoints for duel events and match history.

list.name: Server Processing Layer
list.description: Backend orchestration, validation errors, and worker flows that transform ingested payloads into persisted duel records and admin operations.

list.name: Data Layer
list.description: Prisma access code, server-side models, typed match contracts, and migration/schema assets that define the duel ledger's stored data shape.

list.name: Bot Interface Layer
list.description: Telegram bot runtime files and command metadata that surface stored duel history and stats to end users.

list.name: Test Layer
list.description: Pytest and Vitest suites, shared helpers, and captured fixtures that verify collector behavior, ingest flows, and backend processing contracts.

list.name: Documentation Layer
list.description: Product, architecture, execution, and Cursor skill documentation that explains requirements, workflows, and operational knowledge for the duel logger project.

list.name: Project Support Layer
list.description: Repository-level configuration, local tooling, and miscellaneous support artifacts that shape development and agent workflows around the runtime code.

file:client/tests/test_api.py.summary: Verifies that the backend HTTP wrapper returns parsed responses on success and maps request, status, and JSON failures onto backend error types.

file:client/tests/test_collector.py.summary: Exercises the LCU collector workflow from phase polling through match-history retrieval using scripted fake connection responses. It covers both successful collection and key failure paths around missing or empty game data.

file:client/tests/test_credential_resolv.name: test_credential_resolver.py
file:client/tests/test_credential_resolv.summary: Tests process inspection and command-line parsing for League Client credentials, including sanitized failure messages and partial-flag handling.

file:client/tests/test_main.py.name: test_main.py

file:client/tests/test_parser.py.name: test_parser.py
file:client/tests/test_parser.py.summary: Validates duel-shape checks and payload packing logic for raw LCU match snapshots, including rejection of malformed or non-duel fixtures.

file:client/utils/logger.py.name: logger.py
file:client/utils/logger.py.summary: Initializes process logging from the `LOG_LEVEL` environment variable so the client can emit structured runtime diagnostics.

file:client/lcu/credential_resolver.py.summary: Discovers the League Client remoting port and auth token by inspecting local processes. It sanitizes common failure cases so the capture client can report actionable startup errors.

file:client/lcu/error.py.name: error.py
file:client/lcu/error.py.summary: Defines the shared exception taxonomy for League Client discovery, request handling, duel validation, backend submission, and application state failures.

file:client/main.py.name: main.py
file:client/main.py.summary: Bootstraps the local capture client, drives its runtime state machine, collects a finished duel snapshot from LCU, packs it, and submits it to the backend. This is the executable entry point for the client-side collector.

file:server/src/controllers/data.control.summary: Handles the POST /api/events ingestion endpoint by delegating raw payload intake to the service layer and translating service outcomes into the HTTP contract.

file:server/src/controllers/ingestHttp.t.name: ingestHttp.test.ts
file:server/src/controllers/ingestHttp.t.summary: Unit tests for the ingestion HTTP helpers that verify accepted response formatting and error-to-response mapping behavior.

file:server/src/controllers/ingestHttp.t.name: ingestHttp.ts
file:server/src/controllers/ingestHttp.t.summary: Defines the HTTP response helpers and typed payload shapes used by the ingest controller for accepted, validation, and duplicate outcomes.

file:server/src/errors/ingest.errors.ts.name: ingest.errors.ts
file:server/src/errors/ingest.errors.ts.summary: Defines custom error types for ingest validation failures and duplicate snapshot detection so the service and controller layers can share stable failure semantics.

file:server/src/routes/rawEvent.route.te.name: rawEvent.route.test.ts
file:server/src/routes/rawEvent.route.te.summary: Route-level tests that exercise the POST /api/events endpoint through the Express app while mocking raw event persistence behavior.

file:server/src/routes/rawEvent.route.ts.name: rawEvent.route.ts
file:server/src/routes/rawEvent.route.ts.summary: Registers the lightweight /events ingestion route and wires it to the raw event controller.

file:server/src/services/rawEvent.servic.name: rawEvent.service.test.ts
file:server/src/services/rawEvent.servic.summary: Service tests that verify payload validation, deduplication checks, and Prisma race handling for raw event ingestion.

file:server/src/services/rawEvent.servic.name: rawEvent.service.ts
file:server/src/services/rawEvent.servic.summary: Implements raw event ingestion by validating match snapshots, deriving deduplication keys, preventing duplicates, and persisting accepted events.

file:server/tests/helpers/ingestFixtures.name: ingestFixtures.ts
file:server/tests/helpers/ingestFixtures.summary: Provides reusable test fixtures and helpers for loading snapshot payloads, varying game ids, and building mock RawEvent records.

file:server/tests/integration/ingest.int.name: ingest.integration.test.ts
file:server/tests/integration/ingest.int.summary: Optional live-database integration tests that verify end-to-end ingest behavior, duplicate rejection, and cleanup against PostgreSQL.

file:server/src/app.ts.name: app.ts
file:server/src/app.ts.summary: Creates the Express application instance, installs JSON parsing, and mounts the API route modules. It serves as the shared app object used by the server bootstrap.

file:server/src/controllers/match.contro.name: match.controller.ts
file:server/src/controllers/match.contro.summary: Handles match creation requests by shaping the HTTP payload into a DTO and delegating persistence to the match service. It forms the controller layer between the route and business logic.

file:server/src/index.ts.name: index.ts
file:server/src/index.ts.summary: Bootstraps the HTTP server by importing environment configuration, registering a root health response, and starting the Express app listener.

file:server/src/models/match.model.ts.name: match.model.ts
file:server/src/models/match.model.ts.summary: Provides Prisma-backed data access helpers for creating match records and checking whether a game ID already exists. It is the persistence layer for match storage.

file:server/src/routes/match.route.ts.name: match.route.ts
file:server/src/routes/match.route.ts.summary: Defines the Express router for match-related endpoints and wires POST `/data` requests to the match controller.

file:server/src/services/match.service.t.name: match.service.ts
file:server/src/services/match.service.t.summary: Implements match creation business logic by rejecting duplicate game IDs before delegating record creation to the model layer. It converts inbound match data into a persisted record workflow.

file:server/src/types/type.match.ts.name: type.match.ts
file:server/src/types/type.match.ts.summary: Defines the TypeScript shapes for incoming match payloads and persisted match records used across the controller, service, and model layers.

file:server/src/controllers/rawEventAdmi.name: rawEventAdmin.controller.ts
file:server/src/controllers/rawEventAdmi.summary: Implements admin HTTP handlers for inspecting a stored raw event and resetting one for replay. It translates service results and validation failures into JSON responses with appropriate status codes.

file:server/src/db/prisma.ts.name: prisma.ts
file:server/src/db/prisma.ts.summary: Creates the shared Prisma client used by the server and worker processes. It loads the database connection string from the environment and fails fast when the setting is missing.

file:server/src/models/rawEvent.model.ts.name: rawEvent.model.ts
file:server/src/models/rawEvent.model.ts.summary: Provides the raw-event persistence layer for creating, fetching, and updating ingest queue records. The module centralizes status transitions for pending, processing, failed, processed, and replay workflows.

file:server/src/routes/rawEventAdmin.rou.name: rawEventAdmin.route.ts
file:server/src/routes/rawEventAdmin.rou.summary: Registers Express admin routes for viewing raw events and manually replaying them. The file is a thin routing layer over the raw-event admin controllers.

file:server/src/services/rawEventAdmin.s.name: rawEventAdmin.service.ts
file:server/src/services/rawEventAdmin.s.summary: Provides admin-facing raw-event operations that validate route parameters before delegating to the model layer. It keeps controller logic focused on HTTP concerns instead of bigint parsing and persistence calls.

file:server/src/worker.ts.name: worker.ts
file:server/src/worker.ts.summary: Bootstraps the background raw-event worker process. It loads environment configuration, starts the processor loop, and terminates the process if startup fails.

file:server/src/workers/rawEventProcesso.name: rawEventProcessor.ts
file:server/src/workers/rawEventProcesso.summary: Implements the polling worker that consumes pending raw events and persists match snapshot data into relational tables. It validates payload shape, upserts match and player records inside a transaction, and manages retry or failure state transitions.
